name: research
description: Instrumented component research; not production-equivalence evidence.
limitations: Direct kernel boot bypasses the OEM bootloader and root of trust.
SDHCI PCI compatibility entry is changed in guest memory.
Research bash init replaces vendor systemd/esinit.
Reconstructed rootfs does not reproduce production partitioning or SMACK initialization.
No physical GPU, micom, keystore, CAN, audio or radio hardware.
No NIC, host filesystem passthrough or vehicle connection.
